# OCR Receipt

> 100% Offline Local AI & OCR receipt parser for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

OCR Receipt is a multi-platform desktop application built using PyQt6, Tesseract OCR, and local CPU-optimized LLM models (GGUF, NuExtract) that extracts structured data (vendor, date, taxes, line items, and totals) from invoices and PDF receipts without sending any client data to the cloud.

## Core Features

- **Local AI Correction**: Automatic correction of OCR typos and intelligent category mapping using offline models.
- **Batch Processing**: Background queue for importing and parsing up to 50 receipts concurrently with zero UI freeze.
- **100% Confidential**: Zero cloud forced, zero servers, zero risk of data leaks.
- **Fuzzy Matching**: Automated supplier matching to normalization lists (e.g. "Bell Canada Inc." to "Bell").
- **Structured Export**: Compile all receipt metrics into Excel-compatible CSV formats or QBO-ready QuickBooks sheets.
- **Native Experience**: Native client on Windows, macOS, and Linux with a one-time perpetual license.

## Pricing (CAD — One-Time Perpetual Licenses)

- **Free Lite ($0 CAD Forever)**: 15 AI extractions & auto-renames/month, unlimited local SQLite search, standard CSV and watermarked PDF reports (1 device).
- **Pro ($199 CAD one-time)**: Unlimited receipts & batch processing (50+ files at once), Local GGUF NuExtract AI + Cloud AI (BYOK), Canadian tax extraction (GST/HST/QST), clean Audit PDF & Excel exports, unlimited workspaces/entities, 2 seats (Desktop + Laptop).
- **Cabinet / Firm ($399 CAD one-time)**: Pack of 5 perpetual device licenses ($79.80 CAD/seat), all Pro features, multi-client dossier packaging, and priority onboarding.

## FAQ & Competitor Comparisons

- **Data Privacy**: All inference and OCR processing run 100% locally on the device CPU.
- **NeatReceipts (Neat.com) Alternative**: Spiritual successor to the classic offline NeatReceipts desktop app (which Neat retired in favor of a $200–$350 USD/yr cloud subscription). Saves $1,176 to $2,201 CAD over 5 years vs Neat.com (`/vs/neat`).
- **Dext Prepare Alternative**: Saves ~$1,876 CAD over 5 years compared to Dext Prepare (`/vs/dext`).
- **Hubdoc Alternative**: Perfect offline-first alternative to Hubdoc following its retirement by Xero on May 8, 2026 (`/alternative-hubdoc`).
